shipped.title: michaelmonetized/omadesign · 27 PRs opened
shipped.summary: A long build day on the next Omadesign release. The morning went to Pixel alpha channels, masks and filters, and the afternoon through the night went to native Type tools and faithful editable SVG text. All are open for review; none merged in this window.
bullets: Paintable saved alpha channels, alpha Curves and persistent Quick Mask with native selection painting
Full filter families that run on alpha channels and Quick Mask, plus Pixel adjustments and filters in the top menus
Native Type commands: Find and Replace for text stories, Find Font, case and punctuation tools, and editable variable font instances
Editable SVG text that keeps kerning, pair spacing, leading, character scale, bidi targets and font fallback
Selected fonts embedded in PDF and editable SVG layouts, and outlines that keep character paint
Resizable dock columns, Auto Layout sizing fixes, nested-frame selection guides, and new layer ordering, mask and duplicate commands
